purpose: Track executable and original-resource evidence needed by interface surface-state cells without duplicating screenshot evidence.
proof_rule: Static proof may close resource identity, geometry, predicates, and routing. A surface remains incomplete until all required original-runtime, native, and browser cells pass.

decompiler_corpus.rule: Query the saved Ghidra project when a required exported function is empty; do not treat the text export as complete interface evidence.

unsupported_families: PE type 302 animation frames outside ALSPRITE and EMSPRITE

static_discoveries.proof: Faction-specific galaxy apertures and twelve reference-rail rectangles.
Control rectangles, command IDs, bitmap pairs, mouse capture, command dispatch, state flags, and paint selection.
Managed modeless window creation, rail hit testing, focus, close, and removal behavior.
GID mode/caption branches and display-window creation path.
Alliance/Empire advisor and briefing module selection plus exact advisor apertures.
Tactical module/voice loading and complete battle-manager event registration vocabulary.
Multiplayer template/control mapping, hit testing, timers, receive/send failure, player departure, and teardown paths.
